systems.system: Giga Schools Connectivity Initiative (Giga Maps platform)
systems.owner: Ministry of Education and Training and Ministry of ICT, with UNICEF and ITU
systems.tiers: 965 schools uploaded, 402 of them connected, 87 rejected for faulty records (31 October 2025)

note: A school connectivity briefing of 31 October 2025; the EMIS is named only as a project connectivity will support, with no description of what it does, so it is unclassified and gives no fact. The minister says about 45% of secondary schools are connected (ESSP 2022-2034) and most primary schools are not.
